subject: Slim Pack vs Pro Bundle — feature tradeoffs & downgrade path
messages:

Subject: Packaging question for pilot — Pro vs Slim + discount ask

Hey Mateo,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. We want to lock down packaging for our 3-month pilot. Our product team is split between the full Pro bundle (priority SLAs, extended KV retention, multi-region) and a slimmed-down option that keeps throughput/cost predictable.

High level ask: can you outline the concrete feature differences, the downgrade path if we want to drop to Slim after month 1, and whether we can get a pilot discount for a 3-month commit? Thanks,
Emma

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-09 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Packaging question for pilot — Pro vs Slim + discount ask

Hi Emma — great to follow up. Short answers first:
- Feature delta: Pro Bundle = priority SLA (99.9 p99), 72-hour KV cache retention, multi-region routing, 24/7 SC escalation, and access to Dedicated model variants. Slim Pack = 99.5 p99 best-effort SLA, 6-hour KV retention, single-region, and standard support. Both include the same runtime optimizations and batching settings.
- Downgrade path: you can start on Pro and transition to Slim at any monthly boundary. We will preserve your model pin/version; KV retention reduces automatically and billing prorates to the day. No re-onboarding required.
- Pilot discount: we can offer a one-time 20% pilot credit on committed spend for 3 months, plus a one-week extension of the sandbox environment for testing.

I attached a short matrix (config-matrix.csv) and a proposal PDF that shows pricing buckets and the prorated downgrade example. Key tradeoff for latency is KV retention: longer retention reduces tail latency for repeated sessions; Slim's 6-hour retention still keeps 85-90% of your median latency for typical triage loads.

Next step: if you want, I can schedule a 30-min technical run-through with our infra lead to walk the cache/latency numbers with a sample workload.

Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposal-slim-vs-pro.pdf (pdf, 4 pages), config-matrix.csv (csv, 1 page)
